# Platform operations requirements checklist: Feature 008

**Purpose**: formal reviewer gate for authorization, tenant isolation, economic settings, ability
migration and UI requirement quality
**Created**: 2026-08-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: checklist generated by `$speckit-checklist`; each item evaluates the written requirements,
not the implementation.

## Requirement completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the global Administrator, selected-Tenant Administrator and tenant-user actors distinguished with their respective access boundaries? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-017–018]
- [x] CHK002 Are the six tenant-scoped abilities and the protected platform ability classes explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-015–016]
- [x] CHK003 Are read-only and manage capabilities separately defined for Settings, Users and Roles? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-022, §FR-008-028–030]
- [x] CHK004 Are the approved and deliberately excluded General Settings fields both documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-020–021]
- [x] CHK005 Are account password, retention, audit, notifications, overview and emergency reset requirements retained alongside the new Settings scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-001–014]

## Authorization and tenant-isolation clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the authoritative Tenant source unambiguously defined as `TenantContext` with no client-selected `tenant_id`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008-019]
- [x] CHK007 Are permission-team, actor membership and explicit Administrator-selection rules stated without relying on frontend authorization? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008-017–018, §FR-008-038]
- [x] CHK008 Are cross-Tenant denials required to avoid data disclosure for reads, mutations, roles and users? [Coverage, Spec §Scenari di accettazione, §FR-008-038]
- [x] CHK009 Is protected-ability denial broad enough to cover all platform operations rather than only `platform.tenants.*`? [Security Coverage, Spec §FR-008-016, §FR-008-031]
- [x] CHK010 Is the Administrator's tenant-scoped access defined without membership or impersonation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008-018]

## Privilege-escalation and migration quality

- [x] CHK011 Are arbitrary Permission creation and assignment explicitly excluded from role management? [Security, Spec §FR-008-031]
- [x] CHK012 Is the role lookup available to user managers narrowly specified without implying role-definition access? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008-029]
- [x] CHK013 Does the upgrade requirement define introduction-before-retirement ordering and forbid implicit Editor/Viewer grants? [Recovery/Security, Spec §FR-008-032]
- [x] CHK014 Are existing effective privileges and global Administrator access addressed during migration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-032 and Assumptions]
- [x] CHK015 Are protected, arbitrary, cross-Tenant and platform-role assignment attempts all represented in acceptance scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §Utenti e Ruoli]

## Economic settings quality

- [x] CHK016 Is default VAT behavior defined for both omitted and explicit rates on Expense rows and Contract terms? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-024]
- [x] CHK017 Is the forward-only boundary explicit for current records, revisions and other historical economic data? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008-025]
- [x] CHK018 Are exact persisted VAT/Net/Gross outcomes and the 22.00→20.00 sequence objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §IVA forward-only, §SC-008-003]
- [x] CHK019 Is Base Budget mutability bounded by the first approval and is the UI explanation requirement stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008-026, §FR-008-034]
- [x] CHK020 Are currency immutability, quota separation and absence of retroactive timezone correction explicit? [Boundary, Spec §FR-008-021, §FR-008-027]
- [x] CHK021 Is deletion-reason behavior limited to future Project, Contract and Contract term deletions with historical non-rewrite stated? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008-008]

## UI, accessibility and state coverage

- [x] CHK022 Are the five Settings sections, stable fallback order and hidden unauthorized sections defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008-033]
- [x] CHK023 Is the only-users-view scenario defined so `/impostazioni` does not require access to Generali? [Exception Flow, Spec §Navigazione]
- [x] CHK024 Are explicit save/cancel, non-autosave, VAT helper and budget-lock explanation requirements documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008-034]
- [x] CHK025 Are view-only mutation affordances required to be absent for Users and Roles while readable details remain? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008-035]
- [x] CHK026 Are loading, error, empty, responsive and Italian-copy requirements defined for asynchronous UI surfaces? [Non-Functional Coverage, Spec §FR-008-040]
- [x] CHK027 Is platform Tenant navigation explicitly kept separate and Administrator-only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008-037]

## Failure, recovery and acceptance quality

- [x] CHK028 Are stale locks, inactive actors/Tenants and atomic no-side-effect behavior specified for mutations? [Exception/Recovery, Spec §Edge cases, §FR-008-038]
- [x] CHK029 Are retention confirmation and deletion boundaries precise enough to prevent business/revision/BudgetVersion loss? [Security/Recovery, Spec §FR-008-005]
- [x] CHK030 Are notification empty state and observable email failure requirements stated without realtime/retry assumptions? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-008-012 and Edge cases]
- [x] CHK031 Are secrets, file payload and sensitive metadata exclusions consistently required across audit, notifications, logs and responses? [Security, Spec §FR-008-001, §FR-008-010, §SC-008-005]
- [x] CHK032 Are backend/frontend final gates and feature-local API contract consistency measurable completion signals? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-008-006, §FR-008-039]

## Dependencies and exclusions

- [x] CHK033 Are Feature 009/011/012–016 boundaries and every prohibited infrastructure/framework expansion documented? [Scope, Spec §Fuori scope]
- [x] CHK034 Is the existing permission bootstrap mechanism identified as a dependency without treating historical Spec Kits as executable truth? [Assumption, Spec §Assunzioni e dipendenze]
- [x] CHK035 Is the absence of new CRUD operations such as user reactivation or Permission creation explicit? [Boundary, Spec §FR-008-028, §Fuori scope]

## Notes

- 35/35 requirement-quality checks pass before `$speckit-analyze`.
- Implementation behavior is validated by `tasks.md` test tasks and repository gates, not by this checklist.
